query: INSERT INTO sync_speeds (deployment, network, blocks_per_hour, chain_blocks_per_hour, indexers, head_block, measured_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (deployment) DO UPDATE SET network = EXCLUDED.network, blocks_per_hour = EXCLUDED.blocks_per_hour, chain_blocks_per_hour = EXCLUDED.chain_blocks_per_hour, indexers = EXCLUDED.indexers, head_block = EXCLUDED.head_block, measured_at = EXCLUDED.measured_at
